author: /root/release_fix_review
scope: Exact installed JDK source; no network/signing/test execution
conclusion: Use setFollowRedirects(false), not maxRedirects alone. retryPost=false stops response-side POST retry but JDK failed-write retry remains independent. Root authorized one bounded jarsigner invocation, not exactly one POST.
